title: Ruby gem 1.57.0 fails to install in Windows with Ruby 3.0.6
body:
### What version of gRPC and what language are you using?

Ruby 1.57.0

### What operating system (Linux, Windows,...) and version?

Windows

### What runtime / compiler are you using (e.g. python version or version of GCC)

msys2/mingw64

### What did you do?
Please provide either 1) A unit test for reproducing the bug or 2) Specific steps for us to follow to reproduce the bug. If there’s not enough information to debug the problem, gRPC team may close the issue at their discretion. You’re welcome to re-open the issue once you have a reproduction.

`bundle install` via a GitHub Actions Windows worker. Ruby is installed using the `ruby/setup-ruby` GitHub Action, configured to install version 3.0. The `ruby/setup-ruby` action runs `bundle install` as its last step. The Gemfile.lock is targeting version 1.57.0 of the `grpc` RubyGem.

### What did you expect to see?

The `grpc` RubyGem to install without any errors.

### What did you see instead?

Make sure you include information that can help us debug (full error message, exception listing, stack trace, logs).

The relevant error message appears to be

```
In file included from rb_grpc.h:24,
                 from rb_byte_buffer.c:23:
C:/msys64/mingw64/include/sys/time.h:42:13: error: conflicting types for
'gettimeofday'; have 'int(struct timeval * restrict,  void * restrict)'
   42 | int __cdecl gettimeofday(struct timeval *__restrict__,
      |             ^~~~~~~~~~~~
In file included from
C:/hostedtoolcache/windows/Ruby/3.0.6/x64/include/ruby-3.0.0/ruby/internal/dosish.h:38,
from
C:/hostedtoolcache/windows/Ruby/3.0.6/x64/include/ruby-3.0.0/ruby/defines.h:79:
C:/hostedtoolcache/windows/Ruby/3.0.6/x64/include/ruby-3.0.0/ruby/win32.h:304:12:
note: previous declaration of 'gettimeofday' with type 'int(struct timeval *,
struct timezone *)'
  304 | extern int gettimeofday(struct timeval *, struct timezone *);
      |            ^~~~~~~~~~~~
make: *** [Makefile:246: rb_byte_buffer.o] Error 1
```

### Anything else we should know about your project / environment?

Full build log can be found here: https://github.com/corgibytes/freshli-agent-java/actions/runs/5980364620/job/16226364204

For reproducing, check out Git SHA dc71324df3b6b970ac2a39de4bc9c1c4223a5607 from https://github.com/corgibytes/freshli-agent-java.
